messages:
aline: Heads-up: quick sync to finalize landing microcopy for the upcoming deployment launch. Need concise hero, one-line subhead, micro-CTA copy, and one benchmark badge per mode. Keep copy developer-focused but readable for infra/platform buyers.
tom: Agree. Let's keep two parallel CTAs on Hosted: developer-first and benchmark-led. Single CTA for Dedicated/Private (contact/book) but include a small self-serve link.
rachel: Drafting copy now. Proposals below (super short):
- Hosted: Hero: "Get inference running in minutes  no infrastructure headaches." Subhead: "Hosted API with predictable pricing and streaming." Micro-CTA: "Start free trial" (alt: "Compare latencies") Badge: "p50 (A100) ~ 65ms"
- Dedicated: Hero: "Reserved GPU pools for steady throughput and SLOs." Subhead: "Capacity plans, autoscaling, enterprise SLAs." Micro-CTA: "Request capacity" Badge: "SLA-backed latency targets"
- Private: Hero: "Private deployment in your VPC or on-prem." Subhead: "Keep data in-house with KMS/HSM options and audit logs." Micro-CTA: "Contact enterprise sales" Badge: "SOC2 / ISO-ready"
mike: UX notes: keep hero + subhead tight. Under CTA add tiny helper text: e.g., "No credit card for trial" or "30-min intro call" depending on CTA. That reduces friction. Also add a small toggled benchmark overlay for devs who want model/seq-length details.
aline: Good. On routing/UTM we should map mode preference from webinar signups and social clicks to landing variant. Sample mapping: 
```
utm_map:
  - campaign: launch_2026
    social_post: post_alpha
    landing_variant: hosted
  - campaign: launch_2026
    social_post: post_beta
    landing_variant: dedicated
  - campaign: launch_2026
    social_post: post_gamma
    landing_variant: private
```
tom: Webinar plan: 30 minutes, titled "Serving LLMs in production: concrete tradeoffs". Panels: 1) latency vs cost, 2) rollout strategies & fallbacks, 3) security & private deployments. Registration form should include a picklist: Hosted / Dedicated / Private so we can auto-tag leads.
rachel: Social post drafts (short, varied tone):
- post_alpha: "Launch: simple hosted inference with real benchmarks. See live numbers + demo. Register: <short.link>"
- post_beta: "Need predictable throughput? Learn how reserved capacity reduces tail latency and risk. Register: <short.link>"
- post_gamma: "Compliance-first? Run Redwood in your VPC or on-prem with our enterprise controls. Register: <short.link>"
mike: A/B test suggestion: swap the hero micro-CTA vs benchmark CTA (e.g., "Start free trial" vs "View p50 latency") and measure trial rate from dev audiences. For enterprise lists, surface pricing & SLA copy first.
ops-bot: scheduled webinar page go-live for 2026-04-28 10:00 PT and social blast on 2026-04-21 09:00 PT.
aline: Thanks  please add one image/illustration suggestion inline in the doc: Hosted -> simple API flow diagram; Dedicated -> cluster icon with SLA badge; Private -> shield + server rack. I'll compile final variants and push to the staging page today for QA. Any blockers?
tom: Add tiny trust line under hero: "SLA \u2022 KMS \u2022 VPC" and include a 1-sentence footnote about benchmark methodology (model, seq len).
rachel: Will do. Uploading copy + a11y alt text for images by EOD.
mike: Also adding short JSON snippet for the marketing->infra handoff that maps registration mode to backend tags. I'll paste it into the shared doc.
aline: Perfect. I'll review and send a final approval thread tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
